summary: A tractor-trailer crashed off the Wolf Creek Pass overlook on September 22, 2015, killing the driver. Authorities searched for a possible second occupant, including lowering a search dog to the wreckage, but did not locate another person.
location: Wolf Creek Pass overlook, U.S. Highway 160
responding_agency: Mineral County Sheriff's Office / Colorado State Patrol
notes: DGO retrospective published October 21, 2020 describes the September 22, 2015 crash and subsequent search. Victims=1 counts the confirmed driver fatality; evidence suggesting a second occupant did not establish a second casualty. Reported search outcome is historical.
